halls.title: Philosophy
halls.copy: Choice, meaning, and how to turn a vague worry into a clear question.
domains: 心理学 / 自我成长领域
motions: Is an unexamined life worth living?
Should you follow your passion, or your duty?
Is happiness the point of a good life?
Can you be free if you never choose against your upbringing?

halls.title: Science
halls.copy: Evidence, experiments, and how to keep going when something has not yet produced a result.
motions: Should science stop where conscience begins?
Will AI make human genius obsolete?
Is curiosity enough reason to spend a life on a problem?
Should a scientist ever keep a discovery secret?

halls.title: Business
halls.copy: When product, trade-offs, taste, and market collide.
motions: Should a founder build what users ask for, or what they need?
Is getting rich a worthy life goal?
Should you quit a stable job to start something?
Does great taste matter more than speed?

halls.title: Literature
halls.copy: Turn experiences into sentences and ground emotions in specific events.
motions: Must a writer suffer to write truly?
Is it better to love and lose than never to love at all?
Should you write for readers, or for yourself?
Can a story change a person more than an argument?

halls.title: Art
halls.copy: Style, craft, and what deserves to be seen.
domains: 建筑 / 设计 / 时尚
导演 / 编剧 / 电影大师
motions: Should art please people, or disturb them?
Is AI-made art still art?
Should an artist chase recognition while alive?
Is technique worth more than vision?

halls.title: Politics
halls.copy: Power, timing, and what a person can do when the larger picture is at stake.
domains: 古代文明 / 帝王 / 战略家
社会运动 / 精神领袖
motions: Do the ends ever justify the means?
Is compromise a strength or a betrayal?
Should a leader follow the people, or lead them against their will?
Can one person really change history?

halls.title: Narrative
halls.copy: How fictional characters make decisions and what their choices cost.
domains: 电影 / 动漫 / 小说角色
motions: Is it worth becoming the villain to protect the people you love?
Should you always keep a promise, even when it hurts you?
Is it braver to stay home or to leave on the journey?
Can a good person do a terrible thing and still be good?
